blockingChecks.rule: logicalId values must be globally unique within their declared namespace
canonical output paths must be unique after lowercase normalization
output path must match the registered namespace/category pattern
all raster outputs declare exact pixel dimensions or an approved sheet-layout contract
tile and environment outputs use 48px grid-compatible footprints
standard walk sheets use four directions and three frames per direction unless an explicitly named alternate contract applies
creator layers share the same base canvas, origin and anchor contract
item/equipment icons provide 96px master and 48px runtime contract
transparent PNG classes require alpha-safe edges and no accidental opaque matte
Guardian logical IDs and paths cannot resolve under enemy/hostile namespaces
Chris Bourn, Penney Nguyen, Lily and Ethan cannot resolve as ambient NPC recipes
child NPC and child creator geometry remain explicitly represented
runtime audio is OGG with required loop metadata for looping assets
critical UI information is not encoded by color alone and intense VFX have reduced-flash variants where applicable
every slot declares sourceType, rights/provenance state, replacementStatus and qaStatus
final visual/audio replacement cannot change logical IDs without an explicit migration
asset validation must not create quests, encounters, maps, gameplay systems, economy logic or runtime progression

warningChecks.rule: warn when a category approaches 80 percent of reserved capacity
warn when a region relies excessively on global/shared variants
warn when placeholder/final pack estimates exceed intended mobile packaging budget
warn when major story identities lack the required expression count

knownDeferredCorrection.reason: runtime/gameplay files are outside the current asset-only phase
knownDeferredCorrection.futureRule: rare Guardian appearances must be separated from hostile encounter-family tables before gameplay assembly validation

assetLibraryMayFreezeWhen: all reserved slots have deterministic IDs and paths
binary placeholders are materialized or explicitly represented by validated deterministic generators/recipes
provenance state is complete enough for distribution
